diagnosis: All rollouts settled on 'Hall A' as the auditorium and '180' as the audience capacity, which aligns with the default values of the decisive facts PF1 and PF2. Since the model did not receive the hidden information, it defaulted to the initial values provided, leading to all checks failing. Specifically, C1 and C2 were linked to PF1 and PF2 respectively, but the model did not have access to these facts, causing all checks to fail.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C1 and C2 to ensure they depend on the correct decisive facts PF1 and PF2. For example, adjust C1 to require the auditorium to be 'Hall B' and recording_permitted to be 'False', and adjust C2 to require the audience_capacity to be '140' and the flow to be 'one-way entry'. This will prevent the model from passing these checks by defaulting to the initial values.
